attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado pension/annuity subtraction (2025). Age-based: 55-64 = $20k, 65+ = $24k. Applies to pension and annuity income not already excluded (e.g., not military retirement which has separate exemption). Source: Colorado DOR Form DR 0104. Skeleton table: condition populated as real EL but actions block intentionally empty pending authorship — subtraction assignment to result.co_pension_subtraction not yet wired up. See issue #446.

Colorado state income tax (2025). Flat 4.40% rate (C.R.S. § 39-22-104) applied to federal AGI. CO has no standard deduction; tax = AGI * 0.044. Richer CO-specific subtractions (Social Security, military retirement, pension/annuity per CO_Pension_Subtraction / CO_Military_Retirement_Exemption) are computed in the sibling tables and stored separately; they're not subtracted here yet — a follow-up will integrate them. Writes result.co_taxable_income and result.co_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.co_tax = 0; set result.co_taxable_income = 0; add " Colorado Tax Calculation (Form DR 0104) - flat 4.40% of Colorado taxable income" to job.audit_trail; set result.co_military_retirement_exemption = 0.0; perform co_military_retirement_exemption; add " CO DR 0104AD military retirement / pension subtraction: $" + result.co_military_retirement_exemption to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.co_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef " Colorado Tax Calculation (Form DR 0104) - flat 4.40% of Colorado taxable income" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 cvd /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef /co_military_retirement_exemption performtable " CO DR 0104AD military retirement / pension subtraction: $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: DR 0104 line 1 is federal taxable income (AGI less the federal deductions), line 11 subtracts DR 0104AD (military retirement or pension subtraction), line 13 tax 4.4%
action_details.action_dsl: set result.co_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - (result.state_calc_total_agi - result.taxable_income) - result.co_military_retirement_exemption) and 0.0; set result.co_tax = result.co_taxable_income * co_tax_rate; add " CO taxable income: $" + result.co_taxable_income to job.audit_trail; add " CO state tax (4.40%): $" + result.co_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.state_calc_total_agi result.taxable_income f- f- result.co_military_retirement_exemption f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef result.co_taxable_income co_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.co_tax xdef " CO taxable income: $" result.co_taxable_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " CO state tax (4.40%): $" result.co_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.co_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.co_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.co_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.co_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: Colorado flat 4.4% (2025 104 Book) of Colorado taxable income: federal taxable income (DR 0104 line 1, so the federal deduction is already out) less the DR 0104AD subtraction for military retired pay (line 7 under 55; pension and annuity subtraction line 4 at 55 and over). For a non-resident entry the sourced income less the federal deductions stands in for the DR 0104PN apportionment.

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado Earned Income Tax Credit. Refundable credit equal to 35-50% of federal EITC. Minimum 35%, up to 50% based on economic growth. Expanded eligibility to age 18+ and ITIN holders. Per Colorado DOR 2025. Source: https://tax.colorado.gov/ctc-eitc. Skeleton table: needs authorship.
